From Local Scan Stations to Central Cloud Web Portal

CENTRALIZED EXAMINATION REGISTRY & RUBRIC BLUEPRINTS

Every booklet becomes an encrypted, tamper-evident digital file synchronized to the centralized web portal. Examination coordinators configure master papers, assign Catch Numbers, build question rubrics, invite certified examiners, and execute dual allocation engines.

✓ On-The-Go PDF Assembly

Builds candidate PDF progressively as pages are captured, removing post-scan batch delays and binding Code 128 / QR barcodes.

✓ Automated Duplex Sync

Transmits finalized PDFs from scanning stations to central cloud with transactional commits guarding against partial uploads.

✓ Single Pane of Glass Control

One control room for all examination centers, active scanning batches, evaluator grading velocity, and pending booklet tallies.

Web Stages 03 & 04 Certified Examiner Invitation, Workload Ordering & Allocation
Cryptographic Token Invites • Equal Distribution vs. Daily Quotas • Randomized Order
✓ Examiner Invitation & Workload Ordering Faculty Onboarding

Cryptographic Invitation Tokens: Apex Coordinators issue single-use secure invite tokens to verified faculty, binding evaluators directly to specific examination Subject Codes and qualification tiers.

Evaluator Priority Ordering: Define evaluator priority hierarchies (Primary Marker, Re-checker, Moderator) and establish maximum evaluation capacity caps to prevent examiner fatigue.

✓ Dual Allocation Models (Equal vs. Daily Quota) Production Engine

Equal Distribution + Completion Date Target: Mathematically partitions scanned scripts equally across all verified examiners for that paper, enforced with a strict Completion Date Target deadline.

Daily Allocation Quotas & Randomized Order: Allots scripts in strict daily quota tranches (e.g. 50 scripts/day). All scripts are delivered in randomized order to eliminate bias and prevent collusion.

!
Three-Point Institutional Readiness Verification Gate

Scripts remain strictly locked from evaluation until all 3 conditions pass: [1] Section Rubrics Validated, [2] Certified Evaluators Ordered, [3] Master QP PDF Bound.

Web Stage 05 : Marking Live Question-Wise Rubric Marking Workspace
100% Blind Anonymity • Question Palette • Annotations • Dynamic 0% Tally Summation
https://osm.portal.edu/evaluate/script/view
Marking Workspace
ACTUAL APPLICATION SCREENSHOT: Live Candidate Script Evaluation Workspace 100% Blind Barcode Mask • Question Palette • AI Proctoring Active
  • ✓
    100% Blind Barcode Masking:

    Candidate names, roll numbers, and physical barcodes are automatically masked with system tokens (EXAM-2026_02_07...) guaranteeing zero bias.

  • ✓
    Question-Based Rubric Scoring:

    Clicking any question in Section A/B/C palette opens rubric popup to award marks (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2...) strictly matching that question's configured max marks.

  • ✓
    Precision Annotation Stamps:

    Affix official Green Ticks, Red Crosses, Fractional Points, Text Remarks, and Blank Page stamps permanently recorded into the booklet's audit ledger.

  • ✓
    0% Arithmetic & Tally Errors:

    Dynamic automated aggregation continuously compiles section marks and total scores in real time, completely eliminating manual calculation errors.

✓ Script Checking Time Limits & Anti-Rush Profiles

Mandatory Minimum Time-per-Copy: Administrators enforce a mandatory minimum duration per booklet (e.g. 15 minutes/copy). Marks submission remains locked until the evaluator spends adequate time reviewing every page.

AI Proctoring & Idle Timeouts: Continuous webcam face landmark verification (compareFaces), browser tab-blur detection, and automatic session lock after inactivity.

✓ Dynamic Script Deallocation & Snatching Control

Administrative Script Snatching: If an examiner is inactive, unassigned, or falling behind schedule, coordinators can instantly overwrite allocation counts and snatch un-evaluated scripts back.

Instant Reassignment & Expiry Cleanup: Snatched scripts are immediately returned to the pending pool or reassigned to active examiners, preventing bottlenecks and guaranteeing result publication schedules.
